children: KeyBanc kept Underweight on Apple (AAPL) with $250 PT, saying bigger price hikes may lift margins but cut unit sales, while smaller hikes keep margin pressure and may force later increases.
AAPL grew global smartphone share to 20.2% in Q2. Apple is prioritizing three premium iPhone models, delaying the standard iPhone until next spring. Memory shortages are pushing up smartphone prices.
Bernstein says Apple (AAPL) is gaining market share in China, with shipments there outpacing the broader market based on firm-level channel checks.
Apple (AAPL) faces a UK class action seeking up to £2 billion, alleging its 2021 App Tracking Transparency enforcement disadvantaged third‑party app developers’ ad revenue versus Apple’s services.
Apple's foldable iPhone early output is only a few hundred units daily due to strict quality checks. Company aims for 8–10M units this year. Stock dipped ~2% after the report.
Analyst note: Apple (AAPL) expected to use A20 chip across iPhone 18 lineup, variable-aperture main cameras on Pro models, Apple modems, and an Ultra foldable with dual front/rear cameras.
Apple (AAPL) expected to launch 14.3" and 16.3" OLED MacBook Pros in late 2026; mini‑LED models to stay through 2028. A 13.8" OLED MacBook with under‑display camera possible in 2029.
Apple (AAPL) iPhone 17 starts at $799 for base storage, $200 higher than Nothing 4a Pro's $599 256GB entry, highlighting a price gap relevant for traders tracking handset pricing.
